name: BtttrTags
description: Adds btttr.cc style hanging tags to original movie & series posters across all clients while keeping original artwork safe.
overview: Adds btttr.cc style hanging tags to original movie & series posters.

versions.changelog:
- First public release
- Hanging poster tags for IMDb Top 250 movies and shows, Trending, New Movie, New Series, Just Added, Returning Series and Binge Ready
- Tag colors matched to each poster's artwork, with a gold tag for IMDb Top 250
- Original posters backed up before tagging, and restored when a tag no longer applies
- Runs daily at 04:30, and keeps the last good lists if a download fails
- Restore All Original Posters button for administrators
